content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The teaching positions carry a fixed pay under the Integrated Teacher Education Programme (ITEP). As the course is self-finance, the salary is negotiable. The recruitment process is conducted as per UGC/NCTE guidelines and regulations, and reservation policy will be followed in the recruitment process. The University reserves the right to modify the number of posts, cancel or defer the recruitment process, or not fill any or all posts in accordance with applicable rules. No TA/DA is admissible to candidates for attending the interview.
